lede: Mississippi State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.0 against +7.0, a 1.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Mississippi State -2.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Mississippi State winning 58% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
